account.name: Brightwave Logistics
account.industry: transportation, logistics, supply chain and storage

dossier.summary: Brightwave Logistics is a regional freight broker and carrier with a dispatch floor in Chicago. It moves truckload and less-than-truckload freight for manufacturers across the Midwest.
dossier.why_now: Opened a second dispatch desk this quarter.

reasons.team: We assumed about 1 in 11 of the 201 to 500 people do dispatch work, a typical share for a freight company this size. Change it to your headcount.
reasons.hours: Rekeying loads, chasing carrier updates and building the same reports. We assumed 9 hours a week each.
reasons.rate: Pay for a dispatch coordinator plus benefits and overhead, in US dollars. Change it if your blended cost is different.
reasons.tools: Spreadsheets, a tracking tool and a reporting add-on, as a team this size tends to pay for them. You will know the actual figure.
